comparison.objective: Safely unpack and support an optical instrument versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Support-sensitive transfer, removal of cap/cradle, and placement on a stand versus fine tool insertion, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Instrument placed safely with low tilt, accessories stored, and no drop versus two safe dynamic stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Load support and fragile transfer do not test an adjustable damping mechanism.
